text:
alex: Quick post-AH thread to capture clarifications and owners from today. I'll collect links and publish by tomorrow AM.

rachel: For Dedicated GA timeline: aim is Oct 15, 2026. Milestones: feature freeze 2026-09-10, compliance sign-off 2026-09-30. I'll add dates to the RFC.

mia: Who owns the 32k-context perf work? Need runtime pairing and an applied-ML lead.

dan: I'll take runtime ownership. Setting up INF-3281 for tracking; tagging @mia.

tyler: Rollout checklist will be in product repo today, I'll drop the PR link here when uploaded.

olivia: Sales asked for a simple FAQ: "model pinning vs automatic routing" in plain terms. I can write a short one-pager.
sam: Also want clearer pricing examples showing burst vs reserved. The deck averaged batching and that masked burst costs.
rachel: Finance + product will produce two worked examples (small app and high-throughput). Sam, please paste your demo profile into INF-3410.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Slides + recording -> https://redwood.example.com/ah/2026-03-23

mia: Action items I captured:
- Dedicated GA timeline: rachel (owner) - due 2026-09-30
- Rollout checklist PR: tyler - due today EOD
- 32k tuning RFC & plan: dan + mia - INF-3281 - due 2026-04-06
- Model pinning FAQ: olivia draft + tyler review - due 2026-03-30
- Pricing worked examples: rachel + finance - due 2026-04-13
- Customer canary guide: alex + eng-sre - draft due 2026-04-06

alex: Please create short "AH-ask" cards on the roadmap board for feature requests heard today (2-3 lines, customer + impact) and tag them AH-ask. I'll make a template card.

tyler: Creating the template now and will broadcast it to channels.

olivia: Security follow-up: will HSM be ready at GA for Private?
rachel: Not for GA. GA supports cloud KMS only (AWS/GCP). HSM planned for Private beta post-GA.
dan: Reminder: kernel optimization spike tomorrow 10am to test new fused-attention op. Join if you want perf numbers.
mia: I'm in.
alex: Thanks all. If something missing or you want added as an owner, reply here. I'll publish a follow-up doc with RFC/ticket links tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
